short_description: Brussels-headquartered non-profit European trade association for business angels, early-stage seed funds and other early-stage private-investor communities, founded in 1999 with support from the European Commission and EURADA. EBAN is the pan-European federation of national angel networks, angel groups and family offices; it runs the annual EBAN Congress, publishes the annual European Early-Stage Market Statistics report, and hosts the EBAN Awards. Members include national federations across the EU and DACH, including BAND (Germany), aaia (Austria) and SICTIC / SECA-linked groups in Switzerland.
